rationale: The reviewer identified train/test near-duplicate leakage and showed accuracy collapses to chance (0.52) on test promoters with no close training relative versus 1.00 on the closest ones. They measured 73/100 test sequences sharing substantial k-mers with training, close to the key's ~70/100. They proposed cluster-based re-splitting with MMseqs2/CD-HIT and reporting accuracy versus distance to the nearest training sequence; their other points (baselines, permutation control, sample size) are generic or follow from the leakage.
